# Millwright Data

> Millwright Data is the data platform, governance, and AI advisory practice of Sid Srivastava. It helps companies that run on data with architecture, governance, cloud cost, and the path from a model to production.

Millwright Data operates as Millwright Data LLC in the United States and Millwright Data OÜ in the European Union. Sid Srivastava has run data platforms in semiconductor manufacturing, digital health, hospitality, AAA games, SaaS, and utilities, on Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS.

## Services

- [Diagnostic](https://millwrightdata.com/services/diagnostic/): A number moved and nobody can say why, or a big vendor contract is on the table. Two weeks, a written memo, and a fix-first order.
- [Build](https://millwrightdata.com/services/build/): You know what you need and want it built properly. Designed, built with your engineers, documented, and running in your accounts.
- [Retainer](https://millwrightdata.com/services/retainer/): Your team has the people, but you want a senior data and AI platform leader to stress-test the plan.
- [Head of Data](https://millwrightdata.com/services/head-of-data/): You need a data platform leader before you are ready to hire one. Roadmap, hiring plan, and metrics, then a clean handoff.

## Case studies

- [Cataloging 70,000 datasets across two data platforms](https://millwrightdata.com/work/games-metadata-catalog/): A publisher with several studios and two data platforms had no single place to find a dataset or see where it came from. A structured proof of concept picked the catalog, and the rollout finished early.
- [The data foundation behind a $425M acquisition](https://millwrightdata.com/work/health-data-foundation/): A fast-growing subscription health business needed governed data under HIPAA, PCI DSS, and SOX. The foundation supported its growth analytics and a $425M acquisition.
- [Keeping ML training pipelines at 99.8% uptime](https://millwrightdata.com/work/semiconductor-ml-pipelines/): A semiconductor manufacturer's SaaS MLOps venture needed pipelines that customers could count on. They ran at 99.8% uptime while volumes grew across fabs.
- [Governed reporting across a dozen systems for a resort operator](https://millwrightdata.com/work/hospitality-governance/): A resort operator had a dozen marketing and finance systems and no agreed version of the numbers. A governed lakehouse cut report cycles by 25%.

## Articles

- [Why is our Snowflake bill so high?](https://millwrightdata.com/writing/why-is-our-snowflake-bill-so-high/): Usually because warehouses run longer and larger than the work needs. How billing works, the six usual causes, and the order to fix them in.
- [Do we need a semantic layer before we add AI to analytics?](https://millwrightdata.com/writing/do-we-need-a-semantic-layer-before-ai/): If you want AI to answer questions about your metrics, yes. What a semantic layer does, why AI makes it urgent, and how to start with the metrics in your board deck.
- [When should we hire a fractional head of data?](https://millwrightdata.com/writing/when-to-hire-a-fractional-head-of-data/): When data decisions are piling up faster than anyone senior can make them, but a full-time executive is not yet justified. The signs, the first 90 days, and how it ends.
- [Is our data ready for AI?](https://millwrightdata.com/writing/is-our-data-ready-for-ai/): Ready means you can find it, trust it, trace it, and control who sees it. Four checks, a five-question self-test, and what to fix first.

## Industries

- [Semiconductor](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/semiconductor/): High-volume manufacturing and sensor telemetry, pipeline cost that stays predictable as volumes grow, and ML that reaches production.
- [Healthcare](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/healthcare/): Regulated customer data, fast growth, and controls that have to hold up in an audit or a due diligence room.
- [Hospitality](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/hospitality/): A dozen source systems, three booking channels, and reports that have to reconcile before the Monday meeting.
- [Games](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/games/): Telemetry across studios, player safety at scale, and cost control on a platform that never sleeps.
- [SaaS](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/saas/): Subscription metrics everyone agrees on, pipelines that stay up, and models that ship like code.
- [Compliance](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/compliance/): Regulated data under several rules at once, with access, lineage, and audit trails that hold up to scrutiny.
- [Utilities](https://millwrightdata.com/industries/utilities/): Meter and grid telemetry, systems that outlive their vendors, and regulatory reports that cannot be late.
